Subject: Audio recording of conference call of 
proposed acquisition of Omnia Holdings Limited by 
Solar SA Investments Proprietary Limited
 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
In furtherance to our intimation dated September 14, 2026 , regarding the conference call with analysts 
and investors hosted by ICICI Securities Limited on Tuesday, September 15, 2026
 at 10.30 a.m. IST 
to discuss the proposed acquisition of Omnia Holdings Limited by Solar SA Investments Proprietary 
Limited with the Management of the Company
, kindly note that the audio recording of the 
said 
conference call has been made available on the Company’s website , i.e., www.solargroup.com. 
 
The link for the same is mentioned below: 
URL:  https://solargroup.s.gy/audiorecording15092026 
 You are requested to take the same on your record. 
Thanking You, 
 
For Solar Industries India Limited
